theming_strategy.description: Uses CSS overrides bound to `.lt-theme[data-landing-theme='X']` to hijack hardcoded Tailwind utility classes. This achieves a complete visual overhaul at runtime without massive JSX rewrites.

structural_mapping: .lt-theme[data-landing-theme] button.rounded-md, .lt-theme[data-landing-theme] button.rounded-lg, .lt-theme[data-landing-theme] a[class*='px-'][class*='py-'] { border-radius: var(--radius-btn) !important; transition: border-radius 0.3s ease; }

double_use_resolution.problem: The class `text-slate-900` is used BOTH on white cards (needs to be inverted to light text in dark themes) AND on lime brand buttons (needs to remain dark always).
double_use_resolution.solution: DO NOT globally override `.text-slate-900`. Use Contextual Targetting for the cards instead.
css_implementation: /* 1. Target white cards in dark themes (Classic, Material, Futuristic) */
.lt-theme:not([data-landing-theme='light']) .bg-white { background-color: var(--bg-surface-elevated) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card); }
/* 2. Invert the text ONLY inside those white cards */
/* 3. Result: Lime buttons like `<button class='bg-[#CCFF00] text-slate-900'>` are NOT inside `.bg-white`, so they preserve their dark text organically. */

light: /* Ensure cards have shadow and white background in light mode */
futuristic: /* Add cyber glow to elevated surfaces */
material: /* Remove borders for material design, rely on heavy elevation */

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Inject the `theme_variables` and `css_override_blueprint` into your main CSS file (e.g., globals.css or App.css).
2. Crucially add the `double_use_resolution` CSS exactly as provided to resolve the card vs. lime button contrast conflict.
3. Do NOT run string replacements in the JSX to change tailwind utility classes. Rely on this CSS Override Engine.
4. Ensure ALL interactive elements (buttons, theme toggles, cards) include `data-testid` attributes (e.g. `data-testid='theme-toggle-light'`).
5. Verify that in 'Light' theme, the hero section (originally `bg-slate-950`) successfully flips to `#F8FAFC` and its `text-white` flips to `#0A0F1E`.
6. Verify that in 'Futuristic', everything adopts sharp corners (4px radius) and subtle lime box-shadows.
